overview: This House resolution changes a member's seniority ranking on a House committee. It places Representative Garcia of California ahead of Representative Norton on the Committee on Oversight and Government Reform. Seniority ranking within a committee affects things like the order in which members get to ask questions at hearings and who may lead subcommittees. Resolutions like this are routine internal matters for the House. The House approved it on June 24, 2025.
for: Supporters say it is a routine step that settles the order of members on a committee so it can function smoothly.
against: Critics say it is an internal housekeeping matter that does not change any law or policy.
